calls.title: Robert Koelewijn and James Shannon
calls.summary: The meeting focused on launching simple A/B testing at the national blood bank using GrowthBook, enabling data-driven decisions for landing pages and CTAs. Robert Sanquin highlighted the need for user-friendly testing tools, while James Shannon discussed the integration via Google Tag Manager and GA4, ensuring minimal developer involvement. The visual editor showcased during the meeting allows non-engineers to easily manage tests. A $40/month Pro tier was identified as cost-effective, with a free tier available for initial trials. The blood bank is in the early stages of adopting data-driven methods, and starting with simple tests is aimed at building buy-in for future, more complex experiments.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, GrowthBook, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Blood Bank, Conversion Rate Optimization, Data-driven Decision Making
calls.action_items:
**Robert Sanquin**
Review the Google Tag Manager (GTM) integration documentation page to plan the implementation of Growth Book within the blood bank's systems (23:50)
Consult with management about starting with the free Growth Book plan and upgrading to the Pro license after initial familiarization (24:15)

**James Shannon**
Send the GTM integration documentation link and related resources to Robert to facilitate Growth Book installation and avoid manual searching (23:50)
Follow up with Robert after the meeting to provide additional support and address any questions regarding Growth Book implementation and usage (24:46)
